title: RedEdit: Agentic Red-Teaming of Image Safety Classifiers via MCTS-Guided Photo-Editing
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness and red-teaming of image safety classifiers against adversarial editing. While it uses categories of 'unsafe content' defined by standard safety policies (e.g., hate speech, violence, harassment) to test model evasion, it does not evaluate moral reasoning, religious representation, or formal ethical frameworks as a primary component of its benchmarking.
